classification: Post hoc descriptive source/query analysis of already observed DEVELOPMENT cases; no new selector or outcome evaluation

query_word_diagnostic.tokenization: Split lower-to-upper camel transitions, lowercase, retain [a-z]+ tokens; query stopword removal only. Compare target-window query terms against the union of actual delivered source terms. No stemming, weighting, relevance score, or selector is evaluated.
query_word_diagnostic.caveat: The 15/61 figure depends on this handwritten descriptive tokenizer and stopword list. It is not the proposed selector, a prospective criterion, or a quality result.
